responsibility: Implements 32-bit NVPTX ABI classification by making aggregate arguments and returns larger than 32 bits indirect and otherwise widening scalar values to 32 bits.
same_name_distinction: This `nvptx.rs` is the ABI-calling-convention side of NVPTX: it rewrites function argument and return passing (`FnAbi`/`ArgAbi`) for codegen. Unlike the other `nvptx.rs`, it does not describe inline-assembly syntax or registers at all.
